class: A local 'mirror' of CI that runs only some of CI's steps reports green while CI is red on a step it skips, so a push or merge attempt that relied on it costs a CI round; the mirror must be generated from, or checked against, the CI workflow's own step list rather than maintained by hand.
mechanism: scripts/orchestrator/atool.py ran 5 of the ci.yml lint-and-test steps (lint, trace, findings index, spec refs, settings) plus pytest; it skipped build_order --check, run_smoke, build_spec_index, build_spec_digest --check, spec_dupes, kit_selftest and kit_drift. W-061's status change made views/build-order.md stale; atool said rc 0 everywhere, CI failed build_order --check and kit_drift (STALE generated file), and merge_when_green refused PR #134.

first_seen.evidence: CI: 'build_order: views/build-order.md is stale' and kit_drift 'STALE (generated ...): views/build-order.md'; local atool.py at the same head: all rc 0. After adding the step, atool.py reported 'build_order.py rc 1 | ... is stale' (red), regen.py fixed it, atool.py then rc 0 on all 12 steps (green).

fix: atool.py now runs every ci.yml lint-and-test step in ci.yml's order (kit_settings, factory_lint, trace_check, build_order, run_smoke, build_spec_index, build_spec_digest, spec_dupes, findings index, spec refs, kit_selftest, kit_drift; pytest unless --no-tests); regen.py also regenerates the build order.

detection.note: The mirror is still hand-maintained: a new ci.yml step would be missed again. A test that parses ci.yml's run: lines and asserts atool.py runs each tool is the candidate detection (L2 on a second occurrence). 2026-10-16: the orchestrator's own pushes skipped the mirror entirely; GC-2a carries 'run atool.py <worktree> --no-tests before every push' as a checkable line.

occurrences.evidence: one wasted CI round; merge refused

occurrences.where: GC-1 docs PR #333 (orchestrator, not a builder)
occurrences.evidence: pushed after a hand-picked set of fast checks (lint, trace, coverage, findings index, spec refs, ruff); CI lint-and-test red on 3 skipped steps: build_order --check, build_spec_index --check, and tests/test_tests_required_exist.py (W-087 entries separated by ';'). scripts/orchestrator/atool.py <worktree-dir> --no-tests runs every ci.yml step plus the repo guard tests in ~1 min and would have caught all three.

occurrences.where: GC-2a, PR #327 after merging main (commit e34ede1)
occurrences.evidence: CI api job refused it in 35 s: 'ruff ratchet: E501 rose 632 -> 633' (run 38937916294). atool.py --no-tests had passed every step it runs: it mirrored ci.yml and the guard tests but not the app-tests.yml api job's ruff ratchet or migration guard. Fixed structurally the same turn: atool.py now runs scripts/alembic_migration_guard.py and scripts/ruff_ratchet.py; re-run on e34ede1 -> 'scripts/ruff_ratchet.py rc 1' (red), on f8c19e8 -> OK.
